Legal

Only the English version of the Disclaimer, Cookie Policy and Credits is legally binding. Translations are provided for convenience only and have no legal effect.

HK Transit is an independent information tool. Real-time arrival times, routes, fares and schedules are sourced from public open data (including data.gov.hk and operators’ APIs) and may be delayed, incomplete or inaccurate. This app is not affiliated with the Transport Department, MTR Corporation, KMB, Citybus, NLB or other operators. Always verify with official channels before travelling. Use of this app is at your own risk; the developers accept no liability for loss, delay or decisions made based on the information shown.

This app stores data only on your device via the browser’s localStorage (for example: language, theme, brand colours, pinned routes and high scores). We do not use third-party advertising cookies or track you across sites. Optional location access is used solely to show nearby stops and is not uploaded to our servers. Clearing site data in your browser removes all stored preferences.
